images.title: Colouring the grid: 8 white and 6 black
images.purpose: Show a 5 × 3 grid coloured like a chessboard with the top middle square removed, and the colour counts.
images.composition: The coloured grid on the left; the two counts on the right.
exact_structure: A grid of 5 rows and 3 columns coloured like a chessboard, with all 4 corner squares white and outlined in grey.
Exactly 8 white squares and 6 black squares remain; the top middle square, which would be black, is missing and drawn as a dashed empty outline.
One 2 × 1 tile outline in reddish purple (#CC79A7) placed over two neighbouring squares, covering one white and one black square.
On the right, the text white 8 and black 6.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each tile covers one white and one black square, so 8 white and 6 black cannot be tiled.
images.description: Show a 5 × 3 grid coloured like a chessboard with the top middle square removed, and the colour counts.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.

image_decisions.why: The colouring argument is a picture argument; the counts must be seen on the grid.
